create_resnet152_feature_model: create a ResNet-152 feature extraction model with optional self-attention and fully-connected layers
create_resnet152_with_stage1_weights: create a ResNet-152 feature model loaded with pretrained stage 1 weights from a dataset checkpoint
create_resnet152_for_testing: create a ResNet-152 feature model in test mode without loading any pretrained weights
create_resnet152_with_modulated_attentio: create a ResNet-152 feature model with modulated self-attention enabled for improved feature extraction
create_resnet152_with_custom_log_dir: create a ResNet-152 feature model that loads stage 1 weights from a custom log directory path
